From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Sep 2025 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: vendor security questionnaire route + hosting/PHI clarifications

Hi Alex — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum:

Call recap:
- Use case: document ingestion + summarization for clinician workflows (some PHI).
- Hosting preference: initial hosted Redwood API for speed, but team may require Dedicated or Private for PHI.
- Compliance: you asked about our SOC 2 status, BAA, and whether SIG vs CAIQ is preferred.

Open clarifying questions for you (will save time if you can answer inline):
1) Do you expect to send PHI into Redwood endpoints in the POC, or will PHI only be used in a later production phase?
2) Data residency: do you require EU/regionally isolated hosting, or is US-only acceptable for now?
3) For questionnaires: Is your procurement team requiring SOC2-specific evidence first, or do you want us to prefill a SIG (OpenSSF/Cloud) so your security team can review controls quickly?

Our recommended route based on today:
- Short-term: attach a SOC 2 snapshot for immediate review (attached).
- For the questionnaire: we can prefill SIG (recommended — faster to review) and also accept CAIQ if your security team prefers that standard. I attached a SIG-prefill workbook with our initial answers so you can see the level of detail.
- If PHI is in scope for the POC: we will need to route to our BAA process (we have a standard BAA + escalation for Dedicated/Private deployments).

Proposed next steps (please pick owners/dates):
- You: confirm PHI scope and residency requirement (reply) — target: 48h
- Redwood (me): update prefills per your answer and return revised SIG/CAIQ prefills + decision matrix — target: 48–72h after your reply
- Legal/Procurement sync (if BAA needed): loop Legal once PHI confirmed

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Snapshot_2025-06.pdf (SOC 2 summary), SIG-prefill-answers-20250911.xlsx (initial prefill).

If you prefer a short call to walk through any of the questionnaire answers, happy to schedule a 30-min slot this week.

Thanks —
Sofia Ivanova
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Next steps: vendor security questionnaire route + hosting/PHI clarifications

Sofia — thanks for the concise recap. Quick answers and a few asks from our side: 

Answers:
- PHI: production definitely will process PHI; for the POC we will have a mirror dataset with tokenized PHI, but we want the POC to be covered by the same security controls where possible.
- Residency: US-only is fine for the moment; we may require EU residency for future international pilots.

Questions:
1) Do you have a standard BAA template? We need to review it with legal.
2) For encryption: can you confirm encryption at rest (AES-256) and in-transit (TLS 1.2/1.3)? Also, key management model (customer-managed keys for Private/Dedicated or Redwood-managed for hosted)?
3) For audit logging and retention: what are default retention windows for logs and for customer data? Can we request longer retention for compliance review?
4) On the questionnaire format — our security lead prefers CAIQ. If CAIQ is significantly slower to review from your side, tell us; otherwise we'd prefer CAIQ so it's consistent with our other vendors.

Timeline: procurement would like an initial completed questionnaire and SOC snapshot within one week if possible. Also please indicate whom on your side will own follow-up evidence requests.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Powell
Security & Compliance, MediScript Health
alex.powell@mediscript.com
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Powell <alex.powell@mediscript.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Sep 2025 18:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: vendor security questionnaire route + hosting/PHI clarifications

Alex — great, thanks for the quick details. Short answers inline and I attached a routing matrix that shows recommended paths (SIG prefill vs CAIQ) to help your security lead decide quickly.

1) BAA: yes — we have a standard BAA template. I cannot attach the full agreement to this thread for legal reasons, but I can have Legal send it as a DocuSign when you confirm PHI scope. Owner: Jordan Blake (Legal/Contracts) — cc'd internally.
2) Encryption: AES-256 at rest; TLS 1.2+ in transit. Key management: hosted = Redwood-managed keys by default; Dedicated/Private options support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM).
3) Audit logs & retention: default logs retained 90 days; customer data retention policy is configurable — we can offer extended retention up to 2 years as a feature add-on for the enterprise contract. Specific evidence (access logs, change history) can be exported on request for audit windows.
4) CAIQ vs SIG: absolutely — we can deliver either. Practically speaking:
   - SIG (prefill): faster to review for most security teams because we pre-populate controls with evidence links; good for a first cut.
   - CAIQ: equally acceptable, but our prefill coverage is thinner and may require more back-and-forth.

I've attached: questionnaire-routing-matrix.pdf and a prefilled SIG workbook (SIG-prefill-answers-20250911.xlsx). If your security lead still prefers CAIQ, we'll convert the prefill and flag any answers that need more detail.

Owner for evidence requests: Karthik Iyer will be primary on technical evidence and I will coordinate follow-ups. Jordan will own the BAA. We can commit to returning a SIG prefill + SOC snapshot within 48 business hours once you confirm PHI and residency.

If helpful, I'll schedule a 30-min walkthrough with your security lead tomorrow afternoon.

Best —
Sofia

Proposed immediate actions (owners / ETA):

- Karthik: prepare technical evidence bundle (encryption certs, KMS options, network diagram, default retention settings) and be ready for a quick demo on encryption/key mgmt (48h).

I'll log these action items to HubSpot (RW-4529) and set reminders. Karthik / Jordan — please confirm you can meet these ETAs and any blockers.
